summary: V495 lets a Null subnet run up to 16 mechanisms: MaxAllowedUids may be up to 2500 for any mechanism count, while Yuma keeps the limit of 256 for max UIDs times mechanisms. The global mechanism maximum stays at two until root raises it. A new Null weight row holds at most 2500 divided by the mechanism count entries (error TooManyWeightsForNullMechanism). The Null epoch reads subnet-wide state once, with equal results, and adds an interim weight to the block hook. A deposit that gamma emission opens for a subnet owner has no daily spend cap; deposits from a mint do not change. claim_root_with_hotkey declares weight for the validator's own fund and admits 258 claim units, so a fund with rows on 256 subnets is claimable; it fails with RootClaimTooHeavy if a swap_basket buy or hotkey swap gave that fund a new row in the same transaction. New storage items: BasketRowsOpenedAt, BasketRowsCountedAt. Spec 495 with transaction version 2 needs a metadata refresh. The guide covers 494 too. In parallel, spec 495+ also ships synthetic-mint SHORTS-ONLY lending as a dark-launch pallet (Enabled defaults false): Jacob SPEC v1.2 shorts with root-settable SynthParams, paced forced closes, prune-zone settlement, residual reserve retirement, and dissolution settlement at frozen r. Adds ProxyType::Lending (index 23) for loan-only delegates. Lending is pallet 34; regenerate metadata before integrating.
